summary: TASK-AR-589 adds self-hosted Geist / Geist Mono font tokens and a vendored Lucide inline icon component boundary for the Agent Runtime console.
implemented: Vendored geist 1.7.2 metadata, README, OFL license, Geist variable sans/italic woff2, and Geist Mono variable/italic woff2 under src/agent_runtime/vendor/geist/1.7.2.
Served the Geist woff2 files from ui_console.py under /vendor/geist/1.7.2/... with font/woff2 content type, including percent-decoded bracket filenames.
Added @font-face rules plus --font-sans, --font-mono, and --icon-size tokens in ui_design_assets.UI_TOKEN_SCALE_CSS.
Replaced page-local body and monospace font stacks in ui_console_assets.py with the typography tokens.
Vendored a scoped Lucide static 1.21.0 SVG subset plus package metadata and ISC license under src/agent_runtime/vendor/lucide-static/1.21.0.
Added Python and JavaScript componentIcon(name) helpers that validate names against the vendored subset, return inline SVG, inherit currentColor, and size through --icon-size.
Replaced representative topbar/sidebar HTML entity glyphs with componentIcon SVG output while leaving unclear one-off glyphs untouched.

license_and_asset_boundary.name: geist
license_and_asset_boundary.runtime_boundary: No runtime font CDN dependency; ui_console.py serves local woff2 files and ui_design_assets.py exposes --font-sans / --font-mono tokens.

license_and_asset_boundary.name: lucide-static
license_and_asset_boundary.runtime_boundary: No build-time icon package is required at runtime; componentIcon reads the vendored SVG subset at module import and emits token-safe inline SVG.
